
    /* Primary: Larimar Blue */
    --primary-100: #F2F8FF;
    --primary-200: #BEDEFE;
    --primary-300: #86C5F4;
    --primary-400: #4CA5DA;
    --primary-500: #197BA8;
    --primary-600: #096788;
    --primary-700: #025367;
    --primary-800: #003D47;
    --primary-900: #002326;

    /* Accent: Bloodthirsty Warlock */
    --accent-100: #FFF2F2;
    --accent-200: #FFBBBC;
    --accent-300: #FC838B;
    --accent-400: #F44A60;
    --accent-500: #E6153B;
    --accent-600: #B60731;
    --accent-700: #860229;
    --accent-800: #56001F;
    --accent-900: #260010;

    /* Neutral */
    --neutral-100: #FAFBFC;
    --neutral-200: #E6E8EB;
    --neutral-300: #D2D6DA;
    --neutral-400: #BFC5C9;
    --neutral-500: #ADB4B8;
    --neutral-600: #899093;
    --neutral-700: #666D6F;
    --neutral-800: #44494B;
    --neutral-900: #222626;

/* Untitled blend
 * MOONWASH BLUE #FAFBFC
 * MISTED SKY #F2F8FF
 * RAIN INDIGO #86C5F4
 * ICE HANADA #BEDEFE
 */
.gradient-untitled {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.gradient-untitled::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -180px;
  background: radial-gradient(80% 65% at 16.0% 82.0%, oklch(98.8% 0.0017 247.8) 0%, oklch(98.8% 0.0017 247.8) 22%, #FAFBFC00 72%), radial-gradient(76% 98% at 78.0% 26.0%, oklch(97.7% 0.0113 252.1) 0%, oklch(97.7% 0.0113 252.1) 22%, #F2F8FF00 72%), radial-gradient(43% 34% at 88.0% 84.0%, oklch(79.8% 0.0930 241.6) 0%, oklch(79.8% 0.0930 241.6) 22%, #86C5F400 72%), radial-gradient(40% 35% at 24.0% 16.0%, oklch(88.8% 0.0558 248.5) 0%, oklch(88.8% 0.0558 248.5) 22%, #BEDEFE00 72%), radial-gradient(130% 120% at 30% 20%, oklch(98.8% 0.0017 247.8), oklch(98.8% 0.0017 247.8));
  /* closest CSS field: export SVG or PNG for the full rendering of this type. */
  filter: blur(90px); /* scale with your element size */
}

.gradient-untitled::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: url(data:image/png;base64,) repeat;
  background-size: 256px 256px;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  opacity: 0.090;
  pointer-events: none;
}
